name: smwsprites-potted-spiked-funguy
title: Potted Spiked Funguy
description:
The cactus-like creature from SMW2:YI. It can walk without a pot or jump while riding one depending on the extra bit.

This sprite was part of smkdan's YI Pack 3, and was resubmitted separately after the remoderation for ease of search and to fit current standards.
